soc-strat-01-c1.text: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (2023). Meritocracy. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
soc-strat-01-c1.quote: By tradition, Michael Young is credited with coining “meritocracy” for his 1958 satire, The Rise of the Meritocracy.
soc-strat-01-c1.claim: In 1958 Michael Young satirically called it the 'meritocracy.'
